notes.title: "Meow!!" Game Update - New Control Options
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38982386/ab88a3dfc9082c38ba8d516685033910035afb05.jpg

We are thrilled to announce an exciting update to the "Meow!!" game. Now you can enjoy new ways to play and experience "Meow!!" like never before!

Keyboard Control: Perfect your precision with swift movements using the keyboard. Master each level with ease and efficiency.

Joystick Support: Immerse yourself in the gaming experience by connecting a joystick. Feel fully engaged as you guide the cats on their thrilling journeys.

The choice is yours! Unlock the full potential of "Meow!!" with these new control options.

Download the update now and enjoy an enhanced gaming experience!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2363390
